 Order

J.NISHA BANU,J., AND S.SOUNTHAR,J., This Writ Petition has been filed for a direction to the respondent herein to lift the Look Out Circular (LOC) issued against the petitioner in ECIR No.CEZO-I/01/2018 dated 31.01.2018 and allow the petitioner to travel abroad with due intimation to the respondent / Trial Court, namely, XIII Additional Special Judge for CBI Cases, Chennai as per the directions / mandate of this Court in W.P.No.27686 and 28518 of 2024 dated 06.12.2024.
2.

entities.text: XIII Additional Special Judge for CBI Cases, Chennai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that pursuant to the annulment of the FIR by the High Court of Delhi on 16.09.2025, that was registered in RC221/2018/E0003 dated 22.01.2018 by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) in respect of predicate offences under Sections 120B r/w Section 420 IPC and Section 13(2) r/w Section 13(1)(d)
of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 in Crl.M.C.No.2639 of 2021 and Crl.M.A.No.4776 of 2023,
Crl.M.A.No.15461 of 2025

, this Court has https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
14/10/2025 06:46:23 pm ) quashed the proceedings in Special C.C.No.1 of 2022 before the XIII Additional Special Judge for CBI Cases, Chennai, by an order dated 07.10.2025 in Crl.O.P.No.12147 of 2025.

entities.text: XIII Additional Special Judge for CBI Cases, Chennai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said proceedings were the outcome of the case registered by the Respondent Investigating Agency in ECIR/CEZO-1/01/2018 dated 31.01.2018.

3. Learned Special Public Prosecutor fairly conceded that in view of the quashing of the proceedings in Special C.C.No.1 of 2022, the very genesis / basis for issuing the Look Out Circular against the petitioner does not survive.

4. In view of the above submissions, this Writ Petition is disposed of, with a direction to the respondent herein to lift the Look Out Circular (LOC) issued against the petitioner in ECIR No.CEZO-I/01/2018 dated 31.01.2018 forthwith.
